posts.title: The Same Run Twice
posts.description: Ablation experiments only work if a seeded agent run can repeat exactly. Getting there took a lot more than setting a seed.

posts.title: Deciders on an M5 Ultra
posts.description: I put thirteen local decision models in front of two jobs, approving bash commands and moderating game chat, to find out which ones I can trust to say no.

posts.title: The M5 Ultra Shootout
posts.description: I ran Qwen3.8-27B through every local inference engine I could build on an M5 Ultra, with and without draft models, to find out which ones are actually fast.
